description: Get a one-call intelligence profile for one US ticker: live quote, dealer gamma regime/walls/pin, unusual options flow, squeeze score, SEC fails-to-deliver plus Reg SHO threshold-list status, and the Oracle directive. Use this when an agent needs a full picture of a stock in a single paid call instead of stitching several sources together. Sections that are unavailable are labeled with a reason, never filled in, and a coverage field lists which are live. An unsigned call returns the live x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED challenge (USDC on Base; the challenge states the exact price) and never auto-spends; retry only with a challenge-specific payment_signature. Without a live price it returns an honest not-available result and nothing is charged. A supplied signature authorizes one paid, irreversible x402 settlement. Not investment advice. For example, profile GME before writing a research note.

payment_signature.description: Canonical x402 v2 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE bound to this exact challenge.

symbol.description: US equity or ETF ticker, e.g. SPY, GME, NVDA.

name: ticker_dossier

outputSchema.description: Canonical REST response envelope, or a local/transport rejection. Upstream data remains in body and is defined by the live capability schema.

body.description: Unmodified upstream JSON, or bounded response text. Consult that capability's live schema.

charged.description: Present on local/transport failures; these do not establish an upstream charge.

ok.description: Whether the upstream HTTP status is 2xx; not settlement proof.

payment_required.description: Observed PAYMENT-REQUIRED header; a challenge does not prove payment.

payment_response.description: Observed PAYMENT-RESPONSE header. Assess it together with accepted delivery.

status_code.description: Observed upstream HTTP status, or null when no response was obtained.

title: Ticker Dossier
